items.name: Run your own copy and add the board to any website with one line
items.plain: The demo website has the one line, the line adds the board, and the board page opens.

items.name: Read every topic and reply, with no need to sign in
items.plain: Read the welcome topic and its reply without signing in.

items.name: Sign in with just your email and a one-time code
items.plain: The 6-digit code arrived in the test mailbox and signed me in as 'ann' (the email is not shown). A wrong code was refused.

items.name: Start a topic (bug, idea or question) or reply, with text, links, code and screenshots
items.plain: Posted a Bug topic with a link, a code block and a pasted screenshot; another person replied. All showed correctly, and harmful code came back as plain text.

items.name: Upvote topics, see statuses set by the owner
items.plain: Two upvotes moved the topic to the top, and taking a vote back worked. Only the owner could mark it Planned, and the filters found it.

items.name: Get an email when someone replies to your post
items.plain: The topic's author got 'bob replied to ...' in the test mailbox, with a link back and a turn-off link.

items.name: Rude posts stopped, owner can delete and flag, optional AI check
items.plain: The bad-word check, deleting and flagging all worked. The AI check could not be tried: it shows OFF because there is no Anthropic key here. To try it, add a key (see the README), then switch it on in the Owner's room.

said: 7 of 8 things work. The AI check needs a key to try. I tried everything through requests, not by clicking in a browser, and the copy already running at the address is an older one: restart it to see the latest.
